attributes.background: We should have a three day weekend because we need room to process what we have taught and also some people have a lot more activities and hardly have a break on the weekend and a extra day will help a lot in the long run.

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about the days people work are a matter for individuals and their employers, not the UK Government or Parliament.

We could accept a petition calling for a minimum 3 days off per working week, but it would still be a decision for employers and employees how that was managed.
